fields.topology_type: Daisy-chained (line) single-MainDevice multi-SubDevice fieldbus on standard Ethernet wire, with on-the-fly frame processing replacing classical store-and-forward. Auto-loopback at the last SubDevice's unused port reflects the frame back upstream, so the same cable carries traffic in both directions and one logical bus visits every device twice.

supported_topologies.name: Line / Daisy-Chain
supported_topologies.description: MainDevice → SubDevice₁ → SubDevice₂ → ... → SubDevice_N → (return). Minimum cabling cost.

supported_topologies.name: Tree
supported_topologies.description: Junctions formed by 3- or 4-port SubDevices (EK1100 / ET1815); allows physical fan-out.

supported_topologies.name: Star
supported_topologies.description: All branches off one central multi-port SubDevice.

supported_topologies.name: Ring (cable redundancy)
supported_topologies.description: MainDevice with two NICs closes the cable loop. On cable break, the ring auto-divides into two healthy line segments.

supported_topologies.name: Drop line
supported_topologies.description: Stub branch terminating at a single device.

supported_topologies.name: Hot Connect / Hot Swap groups
supported_topologies.description: Defined groups of SubDevices may join/leave during operation without disturbing the rest.

supported_topologies.name: Mixed
supported_topologies.description: Arbitrary combination of line + tree + star + ring + drop line + hot-connect.

master_slave_role_summary.MainDevice (Master): Single per logical bus during cyclic phase. Originates every frame. Runs configuration tool + cyclic engine + diagnostic interface. No EtherCAT-specific hardware — any standard Ethernet NIC suffices.
master_slave_role_summary.SubDevice (Slave): Up to 65,535 per logical bus. Each contains an EtherCAT Slave Controller (ESC) ASIC or FPGA IP. Processes only the bytes addressed to it via on-the-fly engine; forwards everything else transparently. Cannot originate frames.

fields.interconnect_role: Each ESC integrates 2-4 Ethernet ports + on-the-fly engine + FMMU + SyncManager + DPRAM + DC + SII + PDI. ESC's Port 0 is the upstream side (toward MainDevice). Port 1 (and Port 2/3 on multi-port ESCs) is the downstream side. Every port has hardware-implemented auto-loopback on link-down: if no link partner is detected, the ESC internally closes the loop and forwards arriving frames back through the same port — this is what enables daisy-chain auto-return without explicit configuration.
fields.frame_traversal_pattern: Frame originated by MainDevice → travels outbound through SubDevice₁ Port 0 → forwarded out Port 1 → through SubDevice₂ Port 0 → ... → reaches last SubDevice → auto-loopback on unused Port 1 → travels inbound through SubDevice_(N-1) Port 1 → forwarded out Port 0 → ... → returns to MainDevice. Total wire traversal = 2 × cable length + Σ (2 × ESC forwarding delay).
addressing_in_the_topology: Position addressing (AP cmds): SubDevices identified by their physical sequence on the bus; useful only at start-up.
Configured addressing (FP cmds): SubDevices identified by 16-bit Configured Station Address assigned by MainDevice; identity decouples from physical position.
Broadcast addressing (BC cmds): every SubDevice on the bus.
Logical addressing (LOG cmds): 32-bit network-wide Logical Address space; each SubDevice's FMMUs map a region of this onto local ESC memory.
fields.ordering_guarantees: On-the-fly processing is strictly in-order within one frame; datagrams are processed in the sequence they appear in the frame. Per-cycle ordering is enforced by the MainDevice's cyclic engine. Mailbox messages on SM0/SM1 are point-to-point and in-order between MainDevice and the targeted SubDevice.
fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: ESC's 64-KByte address space is uniformly memory-mapped from both the ECAT wire side and the PDI side. Region 0x0000-0x0FFF is hardware-fixed registers; 0x1000-0xFFFF is configurable DPRAM (typically used for SyncManager buffers).

performance_summary.Cycle time floor: <100 µs (with modern MainDevice + sub-100 SubDevice networks)
